Yes. I understand the goal as:

“Turn my messy pile of bare links into bookmarks I can save quickly, enrich automatically, organize, trust, and find again later.”

That includes editable page details, tags, broad case-insensitive search, a read-later flow, personal notes, duplicate prevention, and archiving without permanent deletion.

Is that direction right? And what kind of app do you have in mind—web, mobile, desktop, or something else?
